method.classification: Heuristic audit of linked document topic/source metadata and text keyword evidence; it is a triage report, not claim verification.
method.basic: Only inventory/location records and no useful topical document.
method.limited: One or two useful topical documents, or at most two topical evidence categories detected.
method.moderate: Several topical categories detected, but the document count or topic spread is below the comprehensive threshold.
method.comprehensive: At least five non-inventory documents, five topical categories, and three distinct topical source URLs; human review is still required for source support and depth.
